Package org.lhssa.ftc.teamcode.pedroPathing

Class PedroSleep

java.lang.Object
org.lhssa.ftc.teamcode.pedroPathing.PedroSleep
public class PedroSleep extends Object
Make the current thread cyclically sleep then call follower.update(). The sleep() durations are controlled using the updateFrequency. Using the default updateFrequency of 250 ms, and a sleep of 3000 ms, follower.update() will be called after sleeping 250 ms. This cycle continues until 3000 total ms have elapsed.
